JanusWeb is a client which is also a direct [XR Hypermedia](https://xrhf.isvery.ninja) viewer for 3D files.

## What does this mean?

It means you can just create a 3D world in a (glTF) file in a 3D editor (like [blender](https://blender.org) or [openbrush](https://openbrush.app)) and link them together:

* https://my.org/world1.glb
* https://my.org/world2.glb
* https://my.org/world3.glb

The key is to add metadata to link them together, this can be done in 2 ways (see sidemenu)
